mappedContracts.statement: Parse frontmatter booleans strictly so false remains false, especially shouldSendEmail.
acceptanceCriteria: shouldSendEmail: false produces boolean false and should_send_email=false.
Quoted true/false are handled deliberately.
Invalid boolean-like values block preflight rather than coercing truthy.
Revision and republish default to no email resend.

mappedContracts.statement: Prohibit guessed POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE endpoint discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown mutations remain planning-only or manual.
Every executable mutation references exact first-party capture evidence, method, request schema, response schema, and last verified version.
Domain, team, refund, moderation, subscriber, publication-setting, revise, and unschedule surfaces are audited.

mappedContracts.statement: Unschedule and published revision preserve the canonical URL where required, default to no resend, reconcile before and after, and never use a schedule endpoint as an unschedule guess.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact captured endpoint and payload evidence exists.
keep-url and no-resend are plan-bound fields.
Issue #168 implementation is retained only if it satisfies the new contract; otherwise it is reverted or replaced.

mappedContracts.statement: Enforce whole-publication schedule collisions, queue caps, maximum horizon, normalized spacing, IANA timezone semantics, DST ambiguity handling, and remote precision tolerances.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue #167 is reused and completed.
Property tests cover DST gaps/folds, multiple series, queue limits, and remote timestamp truncation.
All schedule and note paths use the same policy.

mappedContracts.statement: Publication settings updates require an approved plan and transmit only a strict allowlisted patch with before-state evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Default library calls do not mutate.
Server-managed fields are never echoed back in a merged object.
Logo/favicon partial failures produce compensation.

mappedContracts.statement: Separate official Substack API, undocumented internal creator API, browser automation, and simulator adapters with explicit support and stability labels.
acceptanceCriteria: No undifferentiated 'Substack API' abstraction hides provenance.
Every endpoint records official/internal/browser status, auth, evidence, last verification, and safety state.
Domain logic is transport-independent.

mappedContracts.statement: Expand content, media, scheduling, notes, comments, analytics, backup, and publication-management features only through evidence-backed contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported or probe-only features remain accurately labelled.
Empty valid collections are returned as successful empty results rather than schema drift.
Every feature has dry-run, reconciliation, audit, and recovery semantics appropriate to its risk.
